# Claude Sonnet 4

## ![](claude.png) Anthropic — Claude Sonnet 4

## Model Details

Claude Sonnet 4 is a text generation model.
+ **Model launch date:** May 14, 2025
+ **Model EOL date:** N/A
+ **Model lifecycle:** Active
+ **Context window:** 1M tokens
+ **Max output tokens:** 64K
+ **Reasoning:** Supported

| **Input Modalities** | **Output Modalities** | **APIs supported** | **Endpoints supported** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![Yes](icon-yes.png) Text | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) Text | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) Invoke | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) bedrock-runtime |
| ![Yes](icon-yes.png) Image | ![No](icon-no.png) Image | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) Converse | ![No](icon-no.png) bedrock-mantle |

## Capabilities and Features

**Prompt caching**

| **Prompt caching supported** | **Supported TTL** |
| --- | --- |
| Yes | 5 minutes |

## Programmatic Access

| **Endpoint** | **Model ID** | **In-Region endpoint URL** | **Geo inference ID** | **Global inference ID** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bedrock-runtime` | `anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-20250514-v1:0` | `https://bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com` | `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-20250514-v1:0` | `global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-20250514-v1:0` |

## Regional Availability

| **Region** | **In-Region** | **Geo** | **Global** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| us-east-1 (N. Virginia) | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) |
